d: The Spurs defeated the Timberwolves, 121-111 tonight in San Antonio. Victor Wembanyama contributed a team-high 43 points to go with 6 blocks 7 rebounds and 4 assists, with Dylan Harper of the Spurs adding an additional 25 points (9-17 FG, 2-5 3P) and 25 points in the game.. Ayo Dosunmu finished with a team-high 27 points along with 9 rebounds for the Timberwolves in the losing effort. The Spurs improve their record to 4-2 with the win, while the Timberwolves fall to 4-3 for the season.
